purpose: iPad start-screen concept exploration; not installed in either app.

concepts.name: 01-centered-chord
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-resolution landscape iPad app start-screen artwork, approximately 4:3 aspect ratio, full bleed, no device frame. Brand is Replay, a beautifully restrained piano practice app with a dark neon note-highway aesthetic. Background near-black #08090B. The only text is exactly "Replay", spelled R-e-p-l-a-y, horizontally and vertically centered on the canvas, set in a beautifully spaced bold modern sans serif, crisp and legible. Nothing else written anywhere: no subtitle, UI controls, status bar, loading indicator, mockup labels or watermarks. Musical imagery only, carefully composed, premium and minimal, generous negative space. No conventional floating musical clef or eighth-note clipart. No people or objects besides abstract piano-note or piano-key shapes. Colors from the app: electric lime #CAFF1A, restrained touches of coral red, amber, warm yellow, green and turquoise. Precise flat geometry with a small amount of very soft neon light, no noisy particles or sci-fi textures. Keep "Replay" unobstructed and perfectly centered. Direction 1: CENTERED CHORD. "Replay" in off-white, about 19% of canvas width, at exact center. Immediately above the word, with tasteful separation, a small beautiful mark made of five vertical rounded piano-roll note bars of staggered lengths, like a minimal chord. Dominantly acid lime, one bar in subtle pale yellow, all very crisp with barely perceptible glow. The whole composition otherwise almost empty near-black. Restrained launch identity with a striking centered word. Notes are short rounded rectangular blocks, not keyboard keys or music symbols.

concepts.name: 02-falling-notes
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-resolution landscape iPad app start-screen artwork, approximately 4:3 aspect ratio, full bleed, no device frame. Brand is Replay, a beautifully restrained piano practice app with a dark neon note-highway aesthetic. Background near-black #08090B. "Replay" in bright acid lime, around 24% of canvas width, exact screen center. Several sparse vertical columns of piano-roll note rectangles descend from the top and rise from the bottom edges, varied lengths with neatly rounded corners, leaving a broad completely calm empty region around the centered word. Notes arranged rhythmically with intentional asymmetry, fewer than 18 shapes in total. No gridlines, lanes, keyboard, horizon, or busy backdrop. This should clearly belong to the Replay note highway app but function as a refined quiet splash screen.

"Replay" in crisp off-white, around 22% of canvas width, exact screen center. Along the lower quarter of the image only, an extremely minimal abstract front-facing piano keyboard: broad dark charcoal white-key silhouettes and near-black shorter black-key shapes, rounded at lower ends, consistent 2-and-3 black key grouping.
